summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K disclosing a regulatory notification of major holdings under Irish law. The Capital Group Companies, Inc. reported its voting rights in Ryanair decreased below the 15% threshold to 14.89% as of April 30, 2026. The filing is a routine ownership disclosure, not a special situation. No transaction, corporate action, or strategic event is described. The notification is a standard TR-1 form filed with the Central Bank of Ireland and furnished to the SEC as a foreign private issuer report. No deal terms, board action, or triggering event beyond a passive threshold crossing is present. What to watch / risk-arb angle: None.
